title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Desk Reference Card: Storage Goodwill Waivers
content:
## Scope

Every Repair Estimates & Appointments storage statement charge carries the storage goodwill the desk books for the inconvenience of a long storage; it is booked as one goodwill waiver against that storage charge. The waiver reduces that charge's outstanding amount and carries the waiver reason goodwill.

Storage goodwill is worked out only once the storage charge it relieves stands on the booking.

## How it is invoked

The desk books the storage goodwill with the agent-side tool `waive_storage_goodwill_2cb3c7ba`. The tool is unlocked first and then called by the agent with the goodwill amount already worked out; the tool itself checks no policy condition.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | Reference number of the estimate booking the storage charge belongs to, as returned by the estimate booking lookup | Id |
| `charge_event_id` | Reference number of the storage charge being relieved, as returned by the estimate booking history lookup or by the storage posting receipt | Id |
| `amount_usd` | Goodwill waived on that charge | USD with 2 decimal places, positive; a value with more decimals is rounded half-up to the cent when stored |

## Return

The confirmation names the new waiver reference number (an id beginning with "eev"), the storage charge reference number it reduces and the amount waived in USD with 2 decimals. Seeing that reference number means the goodwill waiver was booked, dated today, and the charge's outstanding amount is lower by that sum; the customer sees the storage charge lowered by that amount on the booking's fee history.
